answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Sampler-stitcher silk panel mark embroidered onto the canvas loft, proved by each silk panel is a season of logged stitch counts plus a signed embroiderer record, checked by strangers. Wanting 394 seats means paying for 394 proofs at 225 POA each, and the 88650 POA is gone before the epoch opens. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. One tide is a pass, one harbor is a fare, one haven is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. Patience is the epoch's coin, and it is the one coin a farm cannot mint.
